info.title: PRISM Engine API
info.description:
Multi-dimensional STEAM career guidance: psychometric + financial vectorisation, financial constraint solver, parent-student conflict index, market blending, SWOT and roadmaps.

All /api/v1 responses use the envelope {success, data, error, meta}. MOCK_MODE is currently **True**.

get.description:
How fresh each dataset is, how much of it has been checked, which live feeds are on, and every
quality-gate finding. Read this before claiming anything is 'real-time'.

post.description: Restore every demo family to its seeded state (live mode); a no-op in MOCK_MODE.
Score without saving: the site calls this as sliders move, so every view shows the engine's result.

k_anonymity_threshold.title: K Anonymity Threshold
k_anonymity_threshold.description: Groups smaller than this are suppressed

response_ms.title: Response Ms
response_ms.description: Optional; very fast answers are down-weighted

student_fit.title: Student Fit
student_fit.description: Present when a run_id is supplied

requirement_vector.title: Requirement Vector
requirement_vector.description: Career vector C in the canonical space

interest_clarity.title: Interest Clarity
interest_clarity.description: How differentiated the RIASEC profile is

contribution.title: Contribution
contribution.description: weight * raw_value * fit gate (negative for disruption); the contributions add up to final_score. The fit gate is 0.5 + 0.5 * min(1, fit / 0.65).

computed_live.title: Computed Live
computed_live.description: Recommendations are recomputed on every request

statement.title: Statement
statement.description: Plain-language summary safe to show judges and users

verified_share.title: Verified Share
verified_share.description: Share of inputs that are verified or secondary-checked

DataTrust.title: DataTrust
DataTrust.description: How much of the data behind one recommendation has actually been checked, and how fresh it is.

cadence_days.title: Cadence Days
cadence_days.description: How often the publisher updates this data

live_feed.title: Live Feed
live_feed.description: true only when an API adapter for this dataset is configured

for_careers.title: For Careers
for_careers.description: Career names in this run that need it

scenario.title: Scenario
scenario.description: One line the presenter can read out

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.description: What this persona proves about the engine

demo_password.title: Demo Password
demo_password.description: Shared demo password; only served when DEMO_MODE=true

fixture_available.title: Fixture Available
fixture_available.description: false = data arrives with the seeded database (Phase 1+)

show.title: Show
show.description: JSON paths in the response worth pointing at

model_inputs.title: Model Inputs
model_inputs.description: Every field the scoring engine reads about a student or family

annual_income.title: Annual Income
annual_income.description: Optional exact figure; band midpoint used if absent

max_affordable_emi.title: Max Affordable Emi
max_affordable_emi.description: Max monthly education-loan EMI the family can bear

time_to_earn_years.title: Time To Earn Years
time_to_earn_years.description: Years until the family expects the child to earn

FamilyFinanceIn.title: FamilyFinanceIn
FamilyFinanceIn.description: Parent-side financial vector. Raw values are visible to parents only.

annual_income.title: Annual Income
annual_income.description: Optional exact figure; band midpoint used if absent

max_affordable_emi.title: Max Affordable Emi
max_affordable_emi.description: Max monthly education-loan EMI the family can bear

time_to_earn_years.title: Time To Earn Years
time_to_earn_years.description: Years until the family expects the child to earn

FamilyFinanceSummary.title: FamilyFinanceSummary
FamilyFinanceSummary.description: What a student sees: no raw rupee figures.

bridge_score.title: Bridge Score
bridge_score.description: Harmonic mean of student_fit and parent_acceptance

family_funds.title: Family Funds
family_funds.description: Family money for the course; null in the student view unless the family shares its finances

loan_capacity.title: Loan Capacity
loan_capacity.description: Null in the student view unless the family shares its finances

loan_required.title: Loan Required
loan_required.description: Null in the student view unless the family shares its finances

monthly_emi.title: Monthly Emi
monthly_emi.description: Null in the student view unless the family shares its finances

burden_ratio.title: Burden Ratio
burden_ratio.description: (monthly_emi + existing EMI) / monthly income; null in the student view unless the family shares its finances

funding_gap.title: Funding Gap
funding_gap.description: Shortfall after funds + scholarships + full loan capacity; null in the student view unless the family shares its finances

admission_chance.title: Admission Chance
admission_chance.description: Estimated chance of getting a seat on this pathway with current scores

reachability.title: Reachability
reachability.description: affordability * (0.5 + 0.5 * admission_chance) * (0.5 + 0.5 * career entry chance); entry chance is below 1 only for careers gated by a very selective exam after the degree

loan_scheme.title: Loan Scheme
loan_scheme.description: Government interest relief applied to the loan, if any

framework.title: Framework
framework.description: Public framework the original items are built on

time_limit_sec.title: Time Limit Sec
time_limit_sec.description: Only the aptitude section is timed

assumed_rate.title: Assumed Rate
assumed_rate.description: Annual interest rate assumed (estimate; banks differ)

moratorium_months.title: Moratorium Months
moratorium_months.description: Course length + 12 months, when banks usually do not ask for EMIs

interest_while_studying.title: Interest While Studying
interest_while_studying.description: Simple interest added during the moratorium, after relief

applies.title: Applies
applies.description: null = need more information (e.g. family income)

starter_project.title: Starter Project
starter_project.description: A concrete project a student could start in 4-8 weeks

is_live.title: Is Live
is_live.description: false = seeded snapshot, not a live feed

consent_on.title: Consent On
consent_on.description: Date the mentor agreed in writing to be listed

verified_by.title: Verified By
verified_by.description: Counsellor or school that checked them

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: How to reach them. Never a phone number or email.

mock.title: Mock
mock.description: true when the payload is a MOCK_MODE fixture

ref_id.title: Ref Id
ref_id.description: exam code / scholarship id / pathway id

source.title: Source
source.description: model = rephrased by the language model; template = fixed wording

facts.title: Facts
facts.description: Exactly what was sent to the language model (anonymised). Every number in the text comes from here.

translation_reviewed.title: Translation Reviewed
translation_reviewed.description: false = Tamil/Hindi wording not yet checked by a native speaker

followed_recommendation_rank.title: Followed Recommendation Rank
followed_recommendation_rank.description: Rank of the chosen career in the run (null = not in the run or not chosen)

suppressed.title: Suppressed
suppressed.description: true = fewer than 5 responses; shares withheld

fee_academic_year.title: Fee Academic Year
fee_academic_year.description: Academic year the fees refer to; inflation starts here

selectivity.title: Selectivity
selectivity.description: How competitive admission is (0 = open, 1 = extremely selective). Estimate.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Only set when it is a real, checkable URL

is_estimate.title: Is Estimate
is_estimate.description: true = illustrative or modelled number, not a checked fact

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Where exactly the figure was checked (document, section, date)

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description:
Attached to every market, salary, fee, exam and scholarship figure.

Rules (enforced here and by DB CHECKs): a figure shown as fact (is_estimate=false) must be verified
or secondary and carry evidence; 'verified' also needs the official URL; disputed figures are always
estimates; URLs are https and only ever real.

Question.title: Question
Question.description:
What the student sees. Which trait an item measures, its reverse keying and the answer key are
deliberately withheld so answers cannot be steered; items are interleaved across traits.

Quota.title: Quota
Quota.description: Admission quota. Drives fees only; never caste or category.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Either a career or a domain

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: E.164, e.g. +919876543210. Required for sms/whatsapp; saved on the caller's account.

input_hash.title: Input Hash
input_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical input snapshot

data_as_of.title: Data As Of
data_as_of.description: Most recent as_of across market/salary/scholarship data used

dataset_version.title: Dataset Version
dataset_version.description: Catalog snapshot the run read; replays use the same snapshot

is_outdated.title: Is Outdated
is_outdated.description: true = newer data exists; offer 'Re-run with latest data'

plan_b.title: Plan B
plan_b.description: Adjacent careers if the primary route closes

npv_earnings_premium.title: Npv Earnings Premium
npv_earnings_premium.description: NPV of 10-yr earnings minus baseline, INR (may be negative)

payback_years.title: Payback Years
payback_years.description: null = does not pay back within horizon

rank_correlation.title: Rank Correlation
rank_correlation.description: Kendall tau over the union of top-k

amount_per_year.title: Amount Per Year
amount_per_year.description: Fixed rupees, or the annual cap for percentage waivers

year_amounts.title: Year Amounts
year_amounts.description: Per-year amounts when they differ by year of study (index 0 = year 1)

exclusive_group.title: Exclusive Group
exclusive_group.description: At most one scholarship per group in a plan

self_declared_criteria.title: Self Declared Criteria
self_declared_criteria.description: Eligibility depends on criteria PRISM does not collect (e.g. social category, gender, disability). Shown so students can check themselves; never used in scoring or automatic plans.

robustness_score.title: Robustness Score
robustness_score.description: Mean Kendall-tau-based rank stability of the top-k

top1_stability.title: Top1 Stability
top1_stability.description: Share of scenarios where the #1 career is unchanged

preferred_regions.title: Preferred Regions
preferred_regions.description: Region codes the student would study/work in

preferred_regions.title: Preferred Regions
preferred_regions.description: Region codes the student would study/work in

client_submission_id.title: Client Submission Id
client_submission_id.description: Set by offline-capable clients; resubmitting the same id is a no-op

gap.title: Gap
gap.description: required - student; > 0 means the student is below requirement

top_riasec_code.title: Top Riasec Code
top_riasec_code.description: Holland code from top-3 RIASEC dimensions

percentile.title: Percentile
percentile.description: null until a real norm group of 200+ students exists

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.description: Response consistency x coverage, after quality-flag penalties
